caption: The image consists of three depictions of the same garment—a shawl or capelet with intricate embroidery—arranged in a horizontal row. In the center, there is a black-and-white photographic image of a person from the neck to the hips, wearing the garment, which is adorned with dense, leafy patterns and has fringes hanging from the edges. The shawl covers the shoulders and drapes down the front. On either side of the photograph, there are two line drawings on white backgrounds. The drawing on the left closely replicates the embroidery and fringe details seen in the photograph, portraying the shawl with a high level of detail using fine lines. The drawing on the right shows the same garment in a simplified manner, with some sections shaded or hatched to indicate texture, while the embroidery and fringe are only partially filled in, leaving other areas unshaded or blank. All three images focus on the garment itself, and the background is a plain, light color.
title: Tracing Technique
